_comment: Inter-agent status declaration. Version-controlled. NOTE ON SEMANTICS: a git-tracked file is NOT a real-time IPC bus — a worktree's edits live on its own branch until merged. Treat this as a COMMITTED DECLARATION of intent: each agent commits its entry when starting/finishing work so the architect (reviewing PRs) and the next session see it. Read all entries before starting; if another agent declares in_progress/review_needed in your file-ownership area, coordinate before editing.

_schema.blocked_by: null | string — worktree name or file name this agent is waiting on
_schema.review_needed: boolean — true = this agent needs architect approval before proceeding
_schema.review_detail: string | null — what architect approval is needed for

usage.how_to_update: Edit your worktree's entry before starting and after completing work; commit it on your branch. Use ISO 8601 timestamps. Set review_needed=true and fill review_detail when you need architect sign-off on an architect-owned file.
usage.how_to_read: Before starting any task, check all other worktrees for status=in_progress or review_needed. If another agent works in your file-ownership area, coordinate before editing.
